evidence_quotes: Waterwet. Watervergunning voor afmeervoorzieningen. Toetsingskader 6.21 en 2.1 Waterwet.
Private belangen eiser kunnen niet leiden tot weigering watervergunning.
rationale: The Dutch administrative court decision directly adjudicates a challenge to a water permit (watervergunning) for mooring facilities under Articles 2.1 and 6.21 of the Dutch Water Act (Waterwet). Under the protocol, Waterwet/watervergunning adjudication is substantively WATER and falls squarely under regulatory_permit, with no household utility connection or informal settlement issue.
